calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-07-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Vantree, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.

Petitioners Xuong Kihn Luong and Phan Tu Giang were present in pro per as guardian ad litem for the minors Hanh Nguyet Luong and Vi Sam Luong, and with Cantonese Interpreter Jenna Zhang. The mother of the minor children is also on calendar for peitition for name change.
Petitioners and Interpreter were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name of a minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name as follows:
Phan Tu Giang to Kitty Giang (mother)
Hahn Nguyet Luong to Hannah Luong(minor)
Vi Sam Luong to Sam Luong (minor)

decreed_name: Kitty Giang; Hannah Luong; Sam Luong
